canonical.name: A sheaf-specific generator and AB5 argument is required before applying the published Grothendieck injective theorem
Arbitrary refinement functions require an ordered-to-alternating Čech translation when they do not preserve index order
The two filtrations of a first-quadrant Čech-injective double complex supply the comparison without assuming a general spectral-sequence page
Associator, symmetry and unitors of the abelian sheaf tensor product are supplied locally from the published module-level tensor laws before any Koszul sign is used on total complexes
